map.温升 ΔT = P / (h × A_eff)，其中 h 为对流换热系数 (W/: Temperature rise ΔT = P / (h × A_eff), where h is the convective heat transfer coefficient (W/m²·K) and A_eff the effective cooling area.
map.有效面积综合铜厚与敷铜覆盖率修正，铜越厚、覆盖越广，热扩散越好。: The effective area is corrected for copper thickness and coverage ratio: thicker and wider copper spreads heat better.

map.5W 板载自然冷却：T 升约 30℃（无铺铜辅助）。: 5W on board with natural cooling: about 30°C rise (no copper pour assist).
map.大铺铜：板面 50cm² 5W → 温升 10℃ 以内。: Large copper pour: 5W over 50cm² gives under 10°C rise.
map.强迫风冷 1m/s：散热系数提升 2~3 倍。: Forced air at 1m/s: the heat transfer coefficient improves 2~3 times.
map.热过孔阵列：芯片下方 9 个 0.3mm via 可降 10℃。: Thermal via array: nine 0.3mm vias under the IC cut 10°C.
map.自然冷却 ΔT≈12℃；环境 25℃ → 板温 37℃；可加 0.5mm 铝基板: Natural cooling ΔT≈12°C; ambient 25°C gives a board at 37°C; a 0.5mm aluminium base plate removes 50%.
map.为何铺铜能降 PCB 温升？: Why does copper pour lower PCB temperature rise?
map.铜导热率 400W/m·K，铺铜扩大散热面积并均温；同时降地线阻抗与 EMI。本: Copper conducts heat at 400W/m·K, so a pour enlarges the cooling area and evens out temperature, while also lowering ground impedance and EMI. This is a basic electronics calculation aid; results are for circuit design and teaching reference only and do not replace formal PCB design, EMC and product reliability requirements.
map.孔径 0.2~0.3mm，间距 1mm；孔内灌锡或铜浆填实，热阻 <5℃/W。本: Use 0.2~0.3mm holes on a 1mm pitch, filled with solder or copper paste so the thermal resistance stays below 5°C/W. This is a basic electronics calculation aid; results are for circuit design and teaching reference only and do not replace formal PCB design, EMC and product reliability requirements.
map.为何多层板散热更好？: Why do multilayer boards cool better?
map.内层铜平面与外层并联热阻；电源/地平面兼散热，热容量大。本工具为电子电路基础辅助: Inner copper planes sit in parallel with the outer layers thermally; power and ground planes double as heat spreaders with high thermal capacity. This is a basic electronics calculation aid; results are for circuit design and teaching reference only and do not replace formal PCB design, EMC and product reliability requirements.
